about: More call time for a seat (decisions 0320 and 0305; redesign RD-19): a member asks for a length from the seat and the floor approves it, or the floor adds one. The length is whole minutes, from 1 to 1,440 (which lengths a venue offers is its setting call_time.add_choices, a list the club types, checked apart from this rule). It is added whole to the later of the seat's call time and the whole minutes played, so time added after the call time is met runs from now. Only a seat with call time (more than nought minutes) can have more, and a call time is at most a day, 1,440 minutes, in all: anything that would pass it is refused, never cut down. A length of nought, below it or past a day is refused.

cases.description: An hour added to a three-hour call time makes four, two hours in.
Half an hour added to three hours, just seated.
Two hours added to five hours.
45 minutes added to three hours.
Played exactly the call time: an hour from now makes four hours.
Met and played on: an hour after 3 h 40 played runs from now, 4 h 40 in all.
Met long ago: 15 minutes after ten hours played makes 10 h 15.
At the cap: an hour onto 23 hours makes exactly a day.
At the cap from time played: four hours after 20 hours played makes exactly a day.
Past the cap by a minute: half an hour onto 1,411 minutes is refused.
Past the cap from time played: an hour after 23 h 30 played is refused.
Past the cap by a minute from time played: an hour after 1,381 minutes played is refused.
Zero: a seat with no call time has none to add to, however long played.
Below zero: a call time that is negative is none to add to.
Not a length, on a seat with no call time: the length is what is wrong.
Any whole length the club types: 50 minutes added to three hours.
The least: one minute added to three hours.
The most that fits: 21 hours added to three makes exactly a day.
A whole day asked of a seat with call time passes the cap.
Not a length: a minute past a day is refused as no length at all.
Not a length: nothing added is refused.
Not a length: a negative length is refused, never taken off.
